D.treatment: interprofessional interventions involving multiple health professions

O.outcome_detail: proportion of interventions characterized as interprofessional

cells.quote: An important highlight was the interprofessional nature of 31% of the interventions, which involved teams made up of different health professionals (nurses, nutritionists, doctors, physiotherapists, among others), aiming at more integrated and effective care.
cells.note: Descriptive analysis of intervention projects; the study does not report a comparative outcome or causal test between interprofessional and other interventions.
